name: test-guard
description: AI-assisted test-after framework: author Vitest tests alongside code, reproduce bugs test-first, discover untested files, run tests + coverage via MCP.

workspace_name.title: Yarn workspace name
workspace_name.description: Package name passed to `yarn workspace <name> vitest`. E.g. @myorg/shared

shared_dir.title: Shared package path
shared_dir.description: Path from project root to the tested package. E.g. packages/shared

scan_dirs.title: Dirs to scan for coverage gaps
scan_dirs.description: Comma-separated subdirs of shared_dir to scan for untested files. E.g. utils,redux,hooks

test_runner.title: Test runner command
test_runner.description: Command used to run tests inside the workspace. Default: vitest run
